summary: S-2 is non-UI and meets C-6. The diff is two new untracked files, src/export.mjs and tests/export.test.mjs, both inside the declared slice paths. Nothing outside the slice changed and no existing test was weakened. exportMarkdown(store) emits '## title', a blank line, the body, and a newline for each note, in store order. An empty store returns an empty string. npm test ran 7 tests: 7 pass, 0 fail. I found no secrets, placeholder data that looks real, or non-English text. Bodies are written verbatim with no escaping, which the criterion does not require.

findings.issue: Bodies are emitted verbatim, so a body line starting with '## ' would look like an extra section. C-6 does not ask for escaping.

evidence.quote: exportMarkdown writes one ## section per note in store order

browser.note: Slice is not UI-bearing, so no browser check was needed.
